continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked workflows with cross-partition support including onCompleted for virtual objects. Complete server-side runtime stack from link creation through completion and cancellation.

progress_update.summary: We added the HandlerInvocation response sink (onCompleted for virtual objects), implemented the CreateLink/RemoveLink service protocol v4 codecs (replacing unimplemented!() panics that would crash production), and consolidated tests. The linked workflows feature is now complete including the deferred onCompleted item. 11 commits on the branch, 7 integration tests + 1 CRUD test all passing.
progress_update.goal: Implement linked workflows with cross-partition support including onCompleted for virtual objects. All server-side runtime work complete.
accomplished: Added ServiceInvocationResponseSink::HandlerInvocation variant with proto/serde wiring and send_response_to_sinks handler
Implemented CreateLink/RemoveLink encode/decode in service-protocol-v4 codec — removed 3 unimplemented!() panics from production code
Added result_completion_id field to CreateLinkCommandMessage proto, reserved deprecated label field
Integration test for onCompleted: child completion triggers both LinkCompletionNotification and ServiceInvocation to parent VO handler
Fixed failure-case argument encoding for HandlerInvocation (passes empty bytes for failure — SDK will define format)
progress_update.now: Feature complete. All production code paths have real implementations (no panics). 7 integration tests + 1 CRUD test passing.
next_steps: Consider squashing commits before merge to main (11 commits → cleaner history)
SDK-side implementation: TypeScript/Java/Python SDK support for startLinkedWorkflow/removeLink/onCompleted
Define failure argument encoding format for onCompleted handlers (currently empty bytes)
Lite entry decoding for CreateLink/RemoveLink (DataFusion query support — currently gracefully skipped)
constraints: Only workflows can enter Completing — VOs complete immediately
HandlerInvocation creates Exclusive handler invocation on parent VO
Failure result passed as empty bytes to onCompleted handler (SDK format TBD)
Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
RemoveLinkCommand cannot trigger Completing→Completed via journal entry (journal entries only dispatched for Invoked/Suspended/Paused)
decisions: Removed label field entirely — links identified by child_service_id, not arbitrary label string
HandlerInvocation targets VirtualObjectHandlerType::Exclusive — handler runs under object's exclusive lock
CreateLink proto uses result_completion_id field (not RawCommand metadata) matching AttachInvocation pattern
Lite decoding for CreateLink/RemoveLink returns graceful DecodingError — DataFusion skips these entries
Extracted cancel_linked_children helper used by cancel (Invoked/Suspended/Paused + Completing) and kill (Completing)
Link barrier check moved outside sinks/retention guard — workflows always enter Completing with running links
No active_children_count — query link table for Running links instead of maintaining denormalized counter
Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
Defer graph traversal API and orphan GC to post-MVP
open_questions: Failure argument encoding for onCompleted: should it be proto-encoded InvocationError, JSON, or raw bytes?
